title: Dreamin' Sun
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Shimana, grieving her mother and feeling displaced by her father's new family, runs away and meets Fujiwara, a young man in a kimono, in a park. He offers her a room in his house on three conditions, including telling him why she left and finding a dream, and she moves in with other teenage residents, Zen and Asahi (Seven Seas blurb; ANN review of volume 1).
life_message: Having a dream and people who believe in you can carry you through grief and a sense of not belonging.
